author: Brent Tyler
reason: Brent confirmed November 19, 20 and 26 date-to-event associations against the scan. Separate transcription corrections remain authoritative.

associations.event: Helicopter landing exercise from USS Princeton to Pendleton
associations.originalReading:
19 NOVEMBER 1965                  CONDUCTED PHIBLEX
                                  The Battalion conducted a PHIBLEX which was a move-
                                  ment by helicopter from the USS PRINCETON to Marine
                                  Corps Base, Camp Pendleton, California.  Three (3)
                                  rifle companies and elements of H&S Co. participated,
                                  however, companies were at approximately 40% manning
                                  level.

associations.event: O’Rourke replaces Garrett as Golf CO; Garrett transfers out
associations.originalReading:

                                  transferred out of the Battalion.
